name: Founder Pack
description: For the people who were here first. The Founder '26 badge on your profile and run cards, Founders Sunset pearl paint, a Founders run-card frame, your name on the Founders roll in the credits if you want it, and both paint packs (eight more paints). Sold until December 31, 2026, then never again. Looks only: it changes nothing about how any car drives or scores.

name: Coast Paint Pack
description: Four paints for every car in your garage: Laguna Tidepool, Crystal Cove Sand, Dana Point Navy (metallic) and Newport Sunset. Included in the Founder Pack.

name: Freeway Nights Paint Pack
description: Four paints for every car in your garage: 405 Midnight (metallic), Interchange Orange, Toll Road Graphite (satin) and Saddleback Dusk (metallic). Included in the Founder Pack.

name: Stripes and Roundels Livery Pack
description: Four liveries over any paint on any car: Twin 405 Stripes, Coast Side Stripe, Two-Tone Roof and a Door Roundel with your own number. Goes on sale only once the livery layer is in the game.

name: Rossini GT Wheel Set
description: Three wheel setups for the Rossini GT, each with its own calipers: Irvine Silver five-spoke, Fullerton Black centre-lock, Tustin Graphite aero. Same size wheels and tyres: looks only.

name: Rossini Brio Wheel Set
description: Three wheel setups for the Rossini Brio, each with its own calipers: Santa Ana Bronze twin-five, Fullerton Black centre-lock, Laguna Pearl aero. Same size wheels and tyres: looks only. Earn the Brio by driving to buy it.

name: Rossini Corsa Wheel Set
description: Three wheel setups for the Rossini Corsa, each with its own calipers: Santa Ana Bronze twin-five, Laguna Pearl five-spoke, Anaheim Gunmetal aero. Same size wheels and tyres: looks only. Earn the Corsa by driving to buy it.

name: Vela E Wheel Set
description: Three wheel setups for the Vela E, each with its own calipers: Irvine Silver twin-five, Fullerton Black five-spoke, Laguna Pearl centre-lock. Same size wheels and tyres: looks only. Earn the Vela E by driving to buy it.

name: Night Shift Driver Style
description: For any driver: black perforated gloves, the Rossini Notte steel watch with a midnight-blue dial, a charcoal bomber's knit cuffs, and plum nails on the female look.

name: Golden Hour Driver Style
description: For any driver: bare hands, the Rossini Ora gold watch with a champagne sunburst dial, a cream linen jacket's cuffs, and sunset-coral nails on the female look.

name: Canyon Run Driver Style
description: For any driver: canyon suede gloves, the Vela Pulse smart watch with a sunset face, an olive field jacket's knit cuffs, and sandstone nails on the female look.

name: Fuel the Build
description: Pay what you want, from $2, to help keep OC Ultra going. You get a small Fuelled the Build badge and our thanks. It unlocks nothing else and the badge is the same at any amount.

name: Rossini GT Coast Aero Kit
description: A front splitter, side skirts and a ducktail for the Rossini GT. Looks only: the GT drives exactly the same.

name: Rossini Brio Street Kit
description: A lip, side skirts and a roof spoiler for the Rossini Brio. Looks only: the Brio drives exactly the same.

name: Rossini Corsa Track Kit
description: Canards, a deeper splitter and a swan-neck wing for the Rossini Corsa. Looks only: the Corsa drives exactly the same.

name: Vela E Aero Kit
description: Aero blades, diffuser fins and a light bar for the Vela E. Looks only: the Vela E drives exactly the same.

name: Rossini GT Spider
description: The open-top Rossini GT. Its numbers are exactly the GT's, and it is also in the showroom for credits: buying it here only skips the credits, never the level. A Spider bought here can't be sold in the garage for credits.

name: Lot 57 Weekend Outfit
description: A denim jacket, tee, jeans and sneakers for your driver on foot at Lot 57. Visiting Lot 57 is free.

name: Lot 57 Night Out Outfit
description: A leather jacket, shirt, trousers and boots for your driver on foot at Lot 57. Visiting Lot 57 is free.

name: OC Ultra Club (monthly)
description: $3 a month, renews monthly until you cancel; cancel online any time in Account. A club badge, a new club paint each month that you keep, and early test builds. No gameplay perks and no extra credits.

name: OC Ultra Club (yearly)
description: $30 a year, renews yearly until you cancel; cancel online any time in Account, and we email you before each renewal. The same perks as monthly. No gameplay perks and no extra credits.
